name: Lazuri
author: GianXander
description: Skip the speed portal at 11.8%, go under the ball portal at 14.8% and then don’t click to fall to the ceiling before the saw at 15%. Stay at the ceiling. Until ~45.7% where you can move to the middle of the screen and then can fall back down at 47% to avoid invisible spikes. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
